name: Operating Systems
short_description: Kernels, concurrency, CPU scheduling, virtual memory, and hardware interaction.
description: Core principles of operating system architecture, process management, multi-threading, concurrency synchronization, virtual memory paging, and storage file systems.

courses.title: Operating Systems Fundamentals
courses.description: System architecture, hardware abstraction, concurrency synchronization, and memory hierarchies.

modules.title: Introduction
modules.description: Role of the OS, dual-mode operation, system calls, and kernel architectures.

topics.title: OS Roles & Kernel Architectures
topics.summary: Monolithic, microkernel, and hybrid kernel designs.

topics.title: System Calls & Dual-Mode Execution
topics.summary: User mode vs kernel mode transitions and trap handling.

modules.title: Processes & Threads
modules.description: Process state transitions, PCB descriptors, threads, and context switching.

topics.title: Process Control Block & Lifecycle
topics.summary: New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated states and PCB contents.

topics.title: Kernel vs User Threads
topics.summary: Thread control blocks, POSIX pthreads, and 1:1 vs M:N thread models.

modules.title: CPU Scheduling
modules.description: Dispatchers, preemptive algorithms, turnaround and response time metrics.

topics.title: Scheduling Criteria & Dispatcher
topics.summary: Throughput, turnaround, waiting, and response times.

topics.title: Preemptive Scheduling Algorithms
topics.summary: Round Robin, Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF), and Priority scheduling.

modules.title: Synchronization
modules.description: Race conditions, critical sections, Peterson's algorithm, mutexes, and semaphores.

topics.title: Critical Section Problem & Mutexes
topics.summary: Mutual exclusion, progress, and bounded waiting requirements.

topics.title: Semaphores & Condition Variables
topics.summary: Counting and binary semaphores, classic dining philosophers problem.

modules.title: Deadlocks
modules.description: Four necessary conditions, resource allocation graphs, Banker's algorithm.

topics.title: Deadlock Characterization & Prevention
topics.summary: Mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, circular wait.

topics.title: Banker's Algorithm & Avoidance
topics.summary: Safe state verification and resource request algorithm.

topics.title: Deadlock Detection & Recovery
topics.summary: Wait-for graphs, the detection algorithm, and recovery by termination or preemption.

modules.title: Memory Management
modules.description: Base/limit registers, logical to physical translation, internal/external fragmentation.

topics.title: Address Binding & Dynamic Relocation
topics.summary: Compile time, load time, and execution time address mapping.

topics.title: Paging & Page Tables
topics.summary: Frames, pages, TLB (Translation Lookaside Buffer) hit rates.

topics.title: Segmentation & Fragmentation
topics.summary: Variable-sized segments, internal versus external fragmentation, and compaction.

modules.title: Virtual Memory
modules.description: Demand paging, page faults, replacement algorithms (FIFO, LRU, Optimal).

topics.title: Demand Paging & Page Fault Handling
topics.summary: Hardware page fault interrupt service routines and disk swap space.

topics.title: Page Replacement Algorithms
topics.summary: FIFO, Least Recently Used (LRU), and Second Chance algorithms.

modules.title: File Systems
modules.description: Inodes, directory structures, contiguous, linked, and indexed disk allocations.

topics.title: File System Structure & Inodes
topics.summary: Metadata storage, inode pointer structures, and open file tables.

topics.title: File Allocation & Directory Structures
topics.summary: Contiguous, linked, and indexed allocation, free-space management, and directory organisation.

modules.title: I/O Systems
modules.description: Device controllers, polling vs interrupts, DMA channels, and disk scheduling.

topics.title: Direct Memory Access (DMA) & Interrupts
topics.summary: Offloading CPU cycle load via hardware DMA controllers.

topics.title: Disk Scheduling Algorithms
topics.summary: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, and LOOK compared by total head movement.

modules.title: Protection & Security
modules.description: Protection domains, access control, and the operating-system defences against attack.

topics.title: Access Control & OS Security Fundamentals
topics.summary: Access matrices, ACLs and capabilities, least privilege, and common attack classes.
